data_summary.data_rights_note: Partner retains full ownership of uploaded data. OligoTox platform does not use partner data to update public models without explicit written consent.

interpretation.hepatocellular_injury: Public baseline AUROC=0.937 on 607 Papargyri LNA gapmers. Partner-enhanced AUROC=0.884 on 787 combined rows. Slight dilution expected when synthetic partner data uses different chemistry (GalNAc-siRNA) from training baseline (LNA). With real proprietary data matching partner modality, enhancement of +0.05 to +0.15 AUROC is expected.
interpretation.renal_tubular_injury: Public baseline trained on sparse labels (n=28). Partner data adds 200 dose-stratified GalNAc-siRNA renal labels. Real partner data with matched species and dose range is the key data gap for this endpoint.

next_steps_for_partner: 1. Share internal dataset using the schema in docs/partner_onboarding_spec.json
2. OligoTox ingests via src/oligotox/partner_import.py (runs inside partner environment)
3. Partner-enhanced models are trained and versioned in artifacts/models/
4. Compare public-only vs partner-enhanced AUROC per endpoint
5. Export this report + model artifacts for internal review
6. Partner data never leaves partner environment unless explicitly authorized
